transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just can’t keep my mind on one thing lately. At work, I’ll be at the bench and start with a customer email, then notice a saw mark, then hear something outside, and before I know it I’ve lost track of the whole work order. It’s starting to mess with my day.
Are you noticing any difficulties with focusing or staying on task outside of work?

Yeah, it’s not just at work. I’ll start doing one thing and then something small catches my attention, and I’m off on that instead. Then I realize I didn’t finish what I was originally doing. It’s like my mind won’t stay put.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

Yeah, definitely. I can’t really sit still at the bench. I’ll start sketching a new watch case, then jump to emailing suppliers, then I’m up rearranging the display trays—even after closing, I’m still moving around doing something.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I do jump between things a lot, but I don’t know if I’d call it acting without thinking. Nothing really stands out to me like that.
Have you ever said something to someone without thinking, and then regretted it?
I’m not sure. I mean, everybody says things they wish they hadn’t once in a while, but nothing really comes to mind as a pattern for me. I haven’t noticed that being a big issue.
Do you often feel like you're constantly on the go, even when you're not at work?

Yeah, I do. Even when I’m not technically working, I feel like I need to be doing something. At the shop I can’t just sit at the bench—I’ll start on a watch case sketch, then suddenly I’m emailing suppliers, then I’m up moving display trays around, even after closing. It’s like I’m still switched on.
Have you ever interrupted others when they were speaking?
I don’t think so. I mean, maybe once in a while if I’m excited about something, but I haven’t really noticed myself cutting people off a lot.
Were you more active or restless than your peers when you were a child?
I don’t really know. I wasn’t told I was unusually restless or anything compared to other kids. I was active, I guess, but I don’t remember it being something people pointed out.
Do you often have trouble organizing tasks and activities?

Yeah, lately I have. My shop records got really disorganized, and I missed a major custom delivery because I couldn’t keep everything straight. It got bad enough that I had to stop taking new work for now. My family’s been checking on me more too, because I’ve kind of slipped out of my normal routine.
Were you often described as fidgety or having a lot of energy when you were a child?
Not that I can really remember. I don’t think people called me fidgety or said I had too much energy as a kid. At least, nobody in my family made a big deal of it.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and restlessness for as long as you can remember?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s been as long as I can remember. I don’t really remember having these problems as a kid. It feels more like something I’ve noticed more recently.
How old were you when you first started noticing these problems with focus and restlessness?
I’m not really sure of an exact age. I don’t remember it being there when I was younger. I guess I only started noticing it more as an adult, but I can’t pin down when it started.
Did you have any problems with paying attention or sitting still in school when you were a kid?

I don’t really remember having problems like that in school. I mean, I probably got bored sometimes like anyone, but I wasn’t known for not paying attention or not being able to sit still, at least not that I can recall.
Did your parents or teachers ever express concern about your behavior or attention when you were a child?
Not that I remember. I don’t think my parents or teachers ever sat me down or said they were worried about my attention or behavior. At least, nothing like that stands out to me.
Have you ever done something impulsively that had significant negative consequences for you?

I don’t know. I can’t think of a specific time where I did something impulsively and it caused major consequences. I’ve made some bad choices like anyone, but nothing that really stands out to me that way.
Were you ever considered impulsive as a child?
Not that I know of. I don’t remember people describing me that way as a kid. I might’ve acted without thinking sometimes, like any kid, but I wasn’t labeled impulsive or anything.
Have your difficulties with focus and restlessness significantly interfered with your relationships or daily life?

Yeah, it has. I missed a big custom delivery at work, and my shop records got so messy that I had to stop taking new jobs for now. My family’s been checking in on me more too, because they could tell I’d gotten pretty far off from my normal routines.
Can you estimate approximately how old you were when you first started noticing these problems with focus and restlessness?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember a clear age when it started. It feels like I only noticed it more recently when it began getting in the way, but I couldn’t say when it first began.
Did you have any problems with attention or behavior as a young child that your parents remember?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really asked my parents about that specifically, and I don’t remember them saying I had attention or behavior problems when I was little.
Did your difficulties with focus and restlessness start during childhood or did they begin later in life?
I honestly don’t know. I can’t say for sure that it started in childhood. I only really noticed it later when it began causing problems, but I don’t have a clear memory of when it began.
